record.title: Myawaddy BGF river checkpoint shut during vehicle-smuggling crackdown
record.region: East and Southeast Asia and Oceania
record.scope: One unnamed BGF crossing on the Moei River near Myawaddy–Mae Sot.
record.direction: Crossing access; usual vehicle flow Thailand to Myanmar.
record.movement: Access to this informal car-trading crossing.
record.imposing_authority: Myanmar Army order, enforced by Border Guard Force soldiers.
record.enforcement: On26 March2018, BGF soldiers denied an Irrawaddy reporter permission to approach the crossing on foot. Local/BGF accounts supply the army closure order; actual international passage refusal was not directly observed.
record.relationship: Distinct informal-gate episode; not EA007 passenger bridge or EA008 cargo bridge.
record.status_observation: Evidence dated in the cited reports; no present status inferred.
record.official_rationale: Vehicle-smuggling enforcement, attributed to local and BGF sources.
record.uncertainty: Order reported after a25 March2018 meeting; first implementation day, checkpoint name and reopening unknown. Refusal to approach the crossing is observed, while the gate-closure order is attributed. Later reporting of reopening at other numbered river gates cannot be matched to this unnamed gate.
